name: aggregate_by_admin_region
description: Aggregate a gridded climate, hazard, exposure, or risk layer into administrative regions using spatial joins and summary statistics.

input_artifact.description: Required input spatial artifact containing GeoJSON features and a numeric value column to aggregate.

admin_boundaries_artifact.description: Optional admin boundary artifact containing GeoJSON polygon features. Use this when boundaries have already been loaded or resolved.

admin_boundaries_path.description: Optional path to a GeoJSON admin boundary file. Relative paths are resolved from data/reference/admin_boundaries/.

value_column.description: Numeric column to aggregate. If omitted, the function uses the value_column metadata from the input artifact.

aggregation_methods.description: Aggregation methods to compute. Supported examples: count, mean, median, min, max, std, sum, variance, p10, p25, p75, p90, p95.

admin_level.description: Optional admin level label, such as admin0, admin1, admin2, province, district, island, or municipality.

admin_name_column.description: Optional column in the admin boundaries containing region names. If omitted, the function tries common names like admin_name, name, district, province, island, or municipality.

admin_id_column.description: Optional column in the admin boundaries containing stable region IDs. If omitted, the function tries common names like admin_id, id, gid, adm_id, or iso_code.

join_method.description: Spatial join method. Supported values: centroid_within or intersects.

keep_admin_regions_without_data.description: If true, return admin regions even when no input features were matched to them.

include_unmatched_warning.description: Whether to include a warning when input features do not match any admin region.

return_geometry_format.description: Geometry output format. Currently only GeoJSON is supported.

input_artifact_type.description: Artifact type of the input layer that was aggregated.

input_layer_id.description: Layer ID of the input artifact, if available.

layer_id.description: Generated layer ID for the admin aggregation output.

variable.description: Climate, hazard, exposure, or risk variable aggregated.

source_variable.description: Original source variable, if different from the derived variable.

admin_level.description: Admin level label used for the aggregation.

admin_name_column.description: Admin boundary column used as the region name.

admin_id_column.description: Admin boundary column used as the region ID.

value_column.description: Main downstream value column, usually the mean aggregation column.

source_value_column.description: Original numeric input column that was aggregated.

geojson.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection containing aggregated admin-region features.

input_feature_count.description: Number of input features before aggregation.

matched_feature_count.description: Number of input features matched to an admin region.

unmatched_feature_count.description: Number of input features not matched to any admin region.

bbox.description: Bounding box as [minx, miny, maxx, maxy].

summary.description: Summary information about input values, matching, and aggregated output values.

provenance.description: Information about spatial join method, admin boundary source, and parent artifact.
